comment: Synthetic samples, NOT recorded from a live run: built from the `codex exec --json` events this package's existing tests already use (thread.started, turn.started, turn.completed with usage, item.* with an agent_message or command_execution item, turn.failed) plus the error event, whose message is read from whichever of message / error / error.message is present. stdout is a list of lines (a JSON object is the line, a string is itself); reply is what the --output-last-message file held. kind is the failure the adapter must report, "" for none; retryAfterSeconds is the reset it must read, when given.

samples.name: a successful turn
samples.reply:
##CODEX TYPE=ANSWER TO=opus
The cookie path differs.

samples.name: an empty reply with a clean exit is the agent saying nothing
an error event Codex recovered from

error.message: stream disconnected before completion: 503 Service Unavailable

samples.name: a usage limit with a reset time, in an error event

stdout.message: You've hit your usage limit. Try again in 2 hours 5 minutes.

error.message: You've hit your usage limit. Try again in 2 hours 5 minutes.

samples.name: a usage limit with no reset time

stdout.error: You've hit your usage limit. Upgrade to Pro or try again later

samples.name: an error event and an exit, with no turn.failed

stdout.message: exceeded retry limit, last status: 529 overloaded

error.message: insufficient_quota: You exceeded your current quota

samples.name: a model the account cannot use

error.message: The 'gpt-6-astra' model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account.

samples.name: a model that does not exist

stdout.message: The model `gpt-9` does not exist or you do not have access to it.

samples.name: not logged in, said only on stderr
samples.stderr:
WARNING: proceeding, even though we could not update PATH
Error: Not signed in. Please run `codex login`.

samples.name: a thread Codex no longer has
samples.stderr: Error: thread/resume failed: no rollout found for thread id 0199a8f2

samples.name: a crash with no recognisable cause
project output mentioning a rate limit is never classified

item.command: go test ./... # rate limit, billing, not logged in

item.text: The API docs mention a rate limit and billing.

samples.name: a turn the runner ended at its time limit
a reply in prose with no header
samples.reply: I looked and it is fine.

samples.name: a reply whose only block has no recipient
